normalization_rules: Case and punctuation differences do not create distinct network identities.
Aliases and rebrands are metadata attached to one canonical identity after evidence review.
An ecosystem stack such as an L2 or L3 family is not itself a canonical network.
Execution planes remain separate where a network exposes materially different native and EVM execution surfaces.
EVM numeric chain IDs are not fabricated for non-EVM execution models.
Testnet/devnet identifiers never promote a production identity.
Protocol deployment overlap is evidence/provenance, not a second chain count.
historical_versioning: Git commit history; do not create new full-registry files for ordinary updates
duplicate_policy: semantic identity resolution before merge; one canonical record per canonical identity
provenance_policy: source evidence remains referenced per record; conflicting observations are preserved outside the canonical object

current_state_accounting.note: Current-state accounting computed from records[]; historical join-point metadata is separate.
